name: ATC_LAUNCH_ENTITIES
description: Stores general information of all launch entities.

columns.name: LAUNCH_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Unique row id of the launch entity.

columns.name: LAUNCH_ENTITY_PUID
columns.description: Indicates identifier of the launch entity.

columns.name: LAUNCH_ENTITY_NAME
columns.description: Indicates name of the launch entity

columns.name: LAUNCH_ENTITY_VERSION
columns.description: Indicates version of the launch entity

columns.name: DISPLAY_NAME
columns.description: Indicates the display name of the launch entity.

columns.name: LAUNCH_ENTITY_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Indicates the description of the launch entity.

columns.name: END_DATE_TIME
columns.description: Indicates the end date of the launch entity.

columns.name: START_DATE_TIME
columns.description: Indicates the start date of the launch entity.

columns.name: REF_ENTITY_PUID
columns.description: Indicates the reference entity identifier.

columns.name: SERVICE_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates the billing service type of entity.

columns.name: BU_ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the business unit id of entity.

columns.name: ENTITY_SEARCH_TAG
columns.description: Indicates the search tag of the launch entity.

columns.name: LIFECYCLE_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the lifecycle status of the launch entity.

columns.name: ENTITY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the type of the launch entity.

columns.name: PROJECT_PUID
columns.description: Indicates the id of the intitiative.

columns.name: PROJECT_NAME
columns.description: Indicates the name of the intitiative.

columns.name: ENTITY_RES_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the resource code of the launch entity.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_INFO
columns.description: Indicates the additional info of the launch entity.

columns.name: LAUNCH_ENTRY_URL
columns.description: Indicates the image url of the entity.

columns.name: LOCKED_FLG
columns.description: indicates whether record is locked for edit or not.

columns.name: API_ENTITY_NAME
columns.description: indicates the API name of the launch entity

columns.name: UI_ENTITY_NAME
columns.description: indicates the UI name of the launch entity.

columns.name: ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Unique row id for the launch entity

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
